items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The real Blues that I heard is Bessie Smith, Ma Rainey, all them -- those are the Blues that I know.

ctx.x: I just wondered if you noticed any differences when you were growing up, what you heard in Arkansas and what you heard in other places.
The real Blues that I heard is Bessie Smith, Ma Rainey, all them -- those are the Blues that I know. This sophisticated Blues... I'm talking the real Blues.
Sophisticated stuff like all the way up to Nat Cole... He put a lot of changes in there.
